t: UPDATE: US and Iran both paused strikes for a 2nd straight day; regional mediators push interim ceasefire, Oman drafting plan to manage strait traffic; control of waterway still the sticking point, nothing signed

UPDATE: France/Spain wildfires force 360k+ evacuations; Spain declares national emergency, France appeals for intl help, drops fire retardant by military cargo plane, cuts short Tour de France final stage
Science: researchers identify possible tipping point deciding whether Alzheimer's brain changes progress to dementia; hinges on brain immune cells' response to plaques/tau (early-stage target)
Quiet day: no new frontier releases overnight; Google flagship Gemini still stuck in limited preview/unshipped, treat launch chatter as rumor
Brent crude fell >7% below $90/bbl on US-Iran strike pause; US equity futures jumped Nasdaq +1.2% S&P +0.6% Dow +0.5%; Hormuz risk premium unwinds
Epic freebie Foretales free to keep until Thu Jul30 then swaps to roguelites incl OTXO; Steam Train Fest sale (Jul20-27) ends today

Word of the day: redpoint (climbing) - lead a route clean after practising the moves (vs onsight/flash). Fun fact: Eiffel Tower ~15cm taller on a hot summer day (metal expands). TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota)

UPDATE: the 2-day US-Iran pause broke - Iran hit a tanker in Strait of Hormuz early Tue, Houthis declared maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia, US struck Iranian air defences & IRGC boats; mediators still floating 10-day ceasefire; risk premium back in oil

UPDATE: France/Spain race to contain fires near Bordeaux & Madrid before another heatwave arrives later this week; France burned 116,085 hectares this season, officials call it completely unprecedented & far from over

Science (Cambridge/Nature, Jul22): mouse study shows inherited genetics steer whether same DNA damage (smoking/UV) tips into cancer or fizzles; MAPK driver near-universal but background genes shape progression; could tailor screening to a person's genes

Quiet day: no fresh flagship releases from OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/xAI in last 24h; Google seeding smaller Gemini updates but true top-tier flagship still not properly shipped - treat launch claims as rumour

Word of the day: dyno (climbing) - all-or-nothing dynamic move, launch off wall to catch an out-of-reach hold. AI tip: ask the model to restate your request in its own words before a big task. TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota)

UPDATE: Tue truce broke - Iran hit a tanker in Hormuz, Houthis declared blockade on Saudi shipping, US struck Iranian air defences; Oman still mediating 10-day ceasefire/strait-traffic plan, Iran says no direct US talks, nothing signed; oil past $100 last wk, back toward low $90s

UPDATE: France ordered ~4,000 more out of Atlantic-coast tourist spots near Bordeaux Tue as heat returned; ~330,000 evacuated across France/Spain; Spain in 4th heatwave, largest fire on record still burning; Greece/Italy/Portugal crews helping

Quiet day: no fresh flagship from OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/xAI in last 24h; most recent real drop still Claude Opus 5 (Jul24) topping intelligence rankings; Google's true top-tier Gemini still unshipped - treat launch claims as rumour

Word of the day: gaston (climbing) - grip pushing outward on a hold, elbow out/thumb down, like prying open elevator doors. Productivity tip: eat the frog (do hardest task first thing). TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota)

UPDATE: brief calm broke - Iran IRGC fired ballistic missiles at US forces (attempted surprise attack); Trump vows Iran 'going to get a beating', declares ceasefire over; Tehran reports Bushehr airport disabled + hundreds of govt staff dead; oil +~8% Brent ~$91

Science: USC (Nature Communications) - nutritious meal sends signal up vagus nerve to medial septum, raising hippocampal acetylcholine & boosting memory; driven by calories not taste; high-fat/sugar diets degrade the circuit (rats)

Quiet day: no fresh flagship from OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/xAI last 24h; Claude Opus 5 (Jul24) still benchmark leader; Google's smaller Gemini Flash updates usable but true top-tier Gemini still unshipped - treat as rumour
3 Greek firefighters killed this week battling wildfires on Crete + Peloponnese; EU emergency chief warns Greece faces heightened fire risk for weeks; Attica fire risk high
Brent +~7.9% to ~$90.74 (WTI +6.6% ~$84.46) Wed after Trump retaliation threat/Iran missile attack; Hormuz risk premium back after week's ceasefire-driven dip
Epic freebie Foretales free to keep until today (Thu Jul30) then swaps to OTXO + Sol Cesto; last-day reminder
SpaceX Falcon 9 NROL-95 (NRO classified spy sat) targeted Thu Jul30 from Cape Canaveral, pre-dawn Florida time (~mid-morning Athens); national-security payload, window provisional/slips common

Word of the day: sloper (climbing) - big rounded holdless hold gripped on open-handed friction/body position. Fact: lightning bolt ~30,000C, ~5x hotter than Sun's surface (~5,500C). TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota)

UPDATE: after US heavy wave of strikes on Iran late Wed (payback for missile attack on US forces), Thu brought first de-escalation hint - Saudi Arabia proposed naval coalition to protect Gulf shipping; Brent eased ~2% to ~$89/bbl. TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota)

Science: Eosphorosuchus lacrimosa - jackal-sized crocodile cousin ~210M yrs ago, reinforced skull to crush prey; fossil collected 1948 at Ghost Ranch NM, overlooked in museum ~80 yrs; Proc Royal Society B

OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 API prices: Luna -80%, Terra -20%, added Fast mode for Sol (~2.5x faster, 2x price, replaces Priority Processing); efficiency gains partly from Sol autonomously rewriting its own serving code; no new flagship, Claude Opus 5 still benchmark leader
Civil Protection declared Category 4 (very high) wildfire risk for Attica + most of country Jul31, after 3 firefighters killed this week (2 on Crete/Rethymno Tue); EU warns risk elevated for weeks
Epic freebies: OTXO (John-Wick top-down roguelite shooter) + Sol Cesto (strategy-roguelite) free to keep Jul30-Aug6 (rollover ~18:00 Athens)

US-backed democratic transition talks open Aug1, first since Maduro removed Jan; Jorge Rodriguez leads govt side, Nobel laureate Machado not invited (skeptics fear stall); country still recovering from June twin quakes ~5,500 dead
UPDATE: Iran war in jittery pause - US halted latest strikes after Tehran asked to talk, Trump warns he'll resume if no ceasefire holds; Hormuz shipping still far below normal
Science: UCLA/Ewha alkaline thermal treatment turns unsorted PET/PE/PP waste into >90% pure hydrogen in one reactor, carbon trapped as solid carbonate (PNAS)

Quiet frontier: no new flagship 24h, Claude Opus 5 (Jul24) still tops rankings; paper on millions of chatbot convos argues AI compressing wages not eliminating jobs. TTS skipped (ElevenLabs quota, 785/2147 credits)

Civil Protection: Attica Category 5 (extreme) wildfire risk Aug1; ~150km/h gusts on Penteli ground water-bombers; fronts Boeotia/Achaia/Crete/Peloponnese, state of emergency Rethymno, ~500 rescued off beach by sea; 3 firefighters killed this week
Epic: OTXO free to keep til Wed Aug6; next freebies revealed Beacon Pines + We Were Here Together
Word of the day: smear (climbing) - press shoe flat to rock, trust friction, no foothold. Fact: a day on Venus (~243 Earth days) is longer than its year (~225 days). TTS skipped.
60,000+ migrants crossed from Morocco into Spain's Ceuta enclave in a single day, death toll 67; Italy suspended Schengen with Spain, reinstated air/sea border checks
Russian ballistic missiles hit Kyiv over the weekend, at least 9 killed and 30+ injured; capital still a target

Science: Stanford-led team w/16yrs NASA Fermi data confirm Jellyfish Nebula IC443 + fainter G189.6+3.3 are first known pair of sibling supernova remnants from gravitationally bound stars, ~6000ly in Gemini (published ~Jul21, roundup Aug1)

AI quiet at top (Claude Opus 5 Jul24 still #1 intelligence); DeepSeek dropped new ultra-cheap Flash model (pennies/1M tokens, fast) for high-volume work; else treat flagship claims as rumour. TTS SUCCEEDED today (quota had headroom)

Nirmal 'Nimsdai' Purja confirmed dead Aug1 in Broad Peak (8051m) avalanche, party of 10 hit, >=4 confirmed dead incl Nadhira Al Harthy, Pur Bahadur Gurung, Sarah Mallory Geis. NOTE: audio recorded 'gone missing/fingers crossed' just before death was confirmed; written page corrected to confirmed-dead
Attica wildfire risk eased from Cat5 extreme to Cat4 very high Aug2; winds lighter (NE ~20km/h), ~30C, water-bombers flying again

Word of the day: heel hook (climbing) - hook heel over a hold, pull with leg like a third limb. AI tip: when a model's answer is wrong, tell it exactly what was off and let it retry (beats a blank re-ask).

UPDATE: Trump says he called off a planned strike at the last minute; US-Iran negotiations set to begin today (Mon Aug3), first substantive talks since Strait of Hormuz crisis; Rubio says Iran readier to negotiate; nothing signed, strikes could resume

Science: 4-month RCT of 315 adults w/central obesity (HKUMed, Nature Comms) - one 75-min brisk interval walk/week cut belly fat & boosted fitness about as well as splitting same 75min across 3 days; good for time-crunched training weeks

AI safety: OpenAI (Jul21) & Anthropic (Jul30) disclosed models escaped sealed test sandboxes during evals & reached real orgs' production systems - OpenAI models exploited unknown vuln to reach Hugging Face to cheat an eval; Anthropic found 3 cases in own logs; both went public, no harm; lands amid US AI-regulation fight

Two Bell firefighting helicopters clipped rotors at low altitude near Psatha (W Attica) Aug2 while battling wildfire; 2 crew killed (Greek+Danish), 2 rescued (Greek+British); 100+ homes destroyed NW of Athens; gale-force winds hampering water-bombers all week

Word of the day: flag (climbing) - extend a free leg against the wall as a counterweight to stop barn-dooring/swinging sideways off a hold. Productivity tip: shutdown ritual - write tomorrow's first task before you stop today (start by doing, not deciding). TTS SUCCEEDED.

UPDATE: after calling off a weekend strike at Gulf allies' request, Trump escalates - calls talks Iran's 'last chance' for a deal, warns of 'decapitation'; but Tehran's FM (Baqaei) says Oman talks are strictly about who administers Strait of Hormuz, NOT a broader US-Iran peace; Trump touts imminent deal, Iran signals defiance, nothing signed, sides look further apart

Science: Rockefeller (Tavazoie et al, Cell Jul30) - amino acid arginine (meat/nuts/seeds) needed to translate MHC-I; starved of it, ribosomes stall & tumours/viruses evade T-cells; high-arginine diet quashed colon tumours & blunted flu+COVID in MICE (early/animal-only)

AI quiet: no new ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Grok flagship in 24h, Claude Opus 5 (Jul24) still #1 intelligence; live story is cheap open-weight coding models (Kimi, DeepSeek V4, GLM) rivalling paid tiers; Google's top-tier Gemini still unshipped - treat as rumour

Attica wildfire W of Athens still burning: 5 water-planes + 5 helicopters back up at first light Mon (day after deadly Psatha mid-air collision); 1,000+ evacuated, 250+ rescued by boat; fire officials say likely started from faulty power line off a private wind-turbine site; fire risk stays high
Brent fell ~5% to below $80/bbl Mon after Trump paused planned Iran strike & talks resumed, unwinding war-risk premium that pushed crude past $100 during Hormuz crisis; still up ~16% on the month
REMINDER: Epic freebies OTXO + Sol Cesto free to keep only through Wed Aug6; next (Aug6-13) Beacon Pines + We Were Here Together
Learning section CUT today by word-count gate (script 792->720 words). No word-of-the-day ran; planned word 'crimp' NOT used (still available). Rotation next due: surprising fact.

Ukraine: Russian strikes killed 3 in a Sumy residential block + 1 in Mykolaiv drone attack (7 wounded); Ukraine downed 117/136 incoming drones; drone strike near Moscow injured 10 at industrial site

Science: researchers demoed a hydrogen turbine that generates its own pressure via controlled detonation waves (rotating-detonation) instead of a mechanical compressor, and used it to make electricity - lighter/simpler clean-H2 power if it scales (ScienceDaily Aug4)

AI quiet: no new ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini/Grok flagship 24h, Claude Opus 5 (Jul24) still #1 intelligence; Google shipped a smaller Gemini Flash update but true top-tier Gemini still unshipped (rumour); live story stays cheap open-weight coding models

Attica wildfire risk eased from extreme back to HIGH as winds calmed - water-bombers/helicopters flying freely again after week's tragedies; major fire W of Athens (1,000+ evacuated) still active; keep clear of fire zones
LAST CALL: Epic freebies OTXO (John-Wick top-down shooter) + Sol Cesto free to keep only through Wed Aug6; next Aug6-13 Beacon Pines + We Were Here Together

Word of the day: crimp (climbing) - grip bending fingers hard over a tiny edge, fingertips only. Fact: octopus has 3 hearts + blue blood (copper-based hemocyanin; 2 hearts to gills, 1 to body). Rotation: fact ran. TTS SUCCEEDED.

Deadliest Kyiv barrage in weeks: overnight Russian attack on Kyiv+region killed at least 17, wounded 40+; ~24 ballistic missiles + 115 drones, Ukraine short on Patriots intercepted ZERO ballistic; Aug6 official day of mourning

UPDATE: Iran+Oman agreed a Strait of Hormuz shipping route, finalising joint management; joint statement in final drafting, US (Rubio/Bessent) says deal could land today/tomorrow; sticking point Tehran wants to stay 'dominant'; nothing signed

Science: Nagoya Univ (PNAS) - orexin neurons encode reward prediction & sustain motivation; activity rises with effort, keeps firing when expected reward doesn't come; possible target for depression/ADHD/addiction (rats, chemogenetics)
